prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Faithful HD PAINTED GAME diffuse UV texture.

Image1 is the exact ENTIRE native stored RGB edit target 128x128. Image2 is ONLY that identical whole source enlarged4x with nearest pixels, to expose the existing tiny paint pattern. Both are the same single canvas. Output ENTIRE same aspect 128:128 canvas and UV, same orientation, no margin/crop/padding/repacking/rotation/zoom. Original full selected alpha restored numerically after this edit.

Full exact dark coat UV atlas. Top three pale arcs are faint soft diffuse paint washes, NOT metal rings or hardware: preserve their weak blurred source shading, no grit, noise, texture, raised rim or bright edge. Three narrow upper-right pale dashes stay weak. Keep original center green/tan plaid grid, small center marks and buckle shapes exactly; all tiny studs and fasteners remain weak source-painted spots. Maintain original stud column count, two columns positions. Broad black cloth and lower tan or reddish slit retain smooth painted appearance. No newly outlined screws, clasps or buttons.

Only improve painted resolution inside the EXISTING shapes. Preserve original palette, matte or shiny material, low contrast and brush softness, relative local lights, all original black gaps/cutouts, and pattern count and scale. Do not redraw little marks into new symbols, add weave/thread/grain/pores/stitches, new folds, bright bevels or hardware. No photograph, new anatomy, new text or new objects. This must remain a faithful old painted game UV texture, no portrait or assembled garment.
review_concern: Whole native source, dual whole guide, complete raw and corrected canvas viewed. Existing diffuse material, field arrangement, old small marks, dark gaps and original pattern counts retained. Coat arcs now soft painted washes, not gritty metal; coats have exact18 binding maxima y30,33,...81. Original alpha exact and global scalar luma verified. Other maps preserve only their actual source forms, including tie, chain count and broad material washes.
